info.title: KYCProbe Flo API
info.description: Flo supports legacy code-owned templates and validated JSON workflows. Every new application pins an immutable published version and definition hash. New links require Flo entitlement, workflow assignment or ownership, active lifecycle and effective workspace settings. Cases and report versions have no automatic expiry.

post.description: Requires Flo module assignment, published and enabled flow, and workspace flow enablement. Idempotency is scoped by workspace ID, flow ID and key; a replay is not billed and returns no supplier URL. Unknown or disabled flows are rejected before billing. Each case pins the exact flow version, definition hash and effective workspace configuration.

flowId.name: flowId
flowId.description: Reviewed flow package ID. The published version and definition hash are pinned on case creation.

CallbackEvent.description: HMAC-SHA256 over x-flo-timestamp + dot + exact JSON bytes, sent in x-flo-signature. Stable event IDs and payloads across retries. Newly created payloads use schema_version 2.0.0 and include flow ID/version/hash, structured checks, AI7EDD review, report summary and incomplete-check reason codes. Historical 1.0.0 events retain their original bytes. Full documents and versioned reports are retrieved through authenticated workspace-scoped APIs.
